title: Indirect prompt injection against an internal AI agent
description: Example scenario using techniques added in ATT&CK v20 alongside ATLAS. Shows how Countermap reports D3FEND coverage gaps for brand-new techniques instead of inventing countermeasures.

steps.description: Poisoned document planted where the agent will retrieve it
Agent invokes a connected tool with attacker-chosen arguments
Data leaves through the agent's own output channel
